utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what do you need done first?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. First thing is sorting the list of broken items and checking what can be fixed before we start.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I’ll sort the broken-item list and mark what can be fixed first.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but we should check the timing and who’s bringing the tools before we promise anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Yeah, let’s confirm the timing and tool list first before we say yes.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Perfect — let’s pin down the time and make sure the tools are covered before we commit.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right—the repair drive. I must’ve missed the details; what’s the latest?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, I’m still trying to pin it down myself—sorry! I think it’s happening soon, but I should check the flyer and get back to you.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: No worries—just let me know when you check the flyer. I’ll keep an eye out too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m telling everyone the repair drive starts this weekend, and I’ll repeat the details again tomorrow so nobody misses it.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Thanks, Vik — I’ll spread the word while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, thanks, Ira — I’ll keep repeating the details so it stays top of mind. See you tomorrow with the full reminder.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m a bit late, but I’m in—what part of the repair drive still needs hands?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Glad you made it—could use an extra pair of hands sorting donated tools and helping with the porch repairs.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I can help sort the donated tools first, then I’ll head over to the porch repairs.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Quinn. Just tell me the time and where to meet, and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Thanks, Eli — let’s meet at my place at 10 a.m., and we’ll head over together.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Quinn. I’ll be at your place at 10 a.m. ready to go.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, what time does the repair drive start?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It starts at 10 this morning at the community center. Want me to walk over with you?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that would help. I’ll meet you there at 10.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’d be happy to help with the repair drive—what do you need most right now?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: We could really use help at the community center and the tool shed by Pine Street. If you can, please check those spots first.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll check the community center and then the tool shed by Pine Street first.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hi Rosa — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Mara — could you help me make a simple sign-up list and spread the word to a few neighbors? That would be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’ll make a simple sign-up list and I’ll tell a few neighbors about it today.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a running list of supplies for the repair drive—what do you still need, Bo?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just send me the short list, and I’ll grab what I can.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Great—here’s the short list: screws, duct tape, gloves, and a couple flashlights.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting started soon—people are already talking about what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I heard that too. I’m mostly keeping track of what folks mention one by one, so I can pitch in where it’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s the best way to do it—little by little, we’ll get a solid list together. I’ll keep you posted if I hear any new trouble spots around the block.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’m ready to help with the repair drive—what details should I check first?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Hana—first check what time the school can receive donations and whether we need a sign-in list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—I’ll confirm the donation hours and ask if they want a sign-in list at the door.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what’s the repair drive needing from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Mostly donations and a few hands to sort things out. If you’ve got a spare hour, I’d say that helps plenty.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: I can spare an hour. Point me to where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll spread the word about the repair drive and make sure folks know what time it starts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Vik — I really appreciate that. Let me know if you need the details or flyers to pass along.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Absolutely — send me the details and flyers, and I’ll make sure people get the word.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right — the repair drive. I might've missed the latest details, but I’m in if you need a hand.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Noah. I’m keeping it low-key for now, but I’ll let you know if I need help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Sounds good — just give me a shout if anything comes up.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out a bit—what kind of repairs are needed?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Mostly small stuff—leaky faucets, squeaky hinges, and a few loose cabinet doors. If you’ve got time, I could really use an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Sure, I can help with that. Point me to the first one, and I’ll get started.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Opal — I’ve got the repair drive organized and I’m ready to help however you need. What should we tackle first?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Rosa — can you check the rear gate first and tell me if the latch is still sticking?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll check the rear gate latch first and let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m in, but I’d like to know the timing and where the drop-off is first.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Totally — I’ll check the timing and drop-off spot and get right back to you. If you want, I can also send the invite as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Yes, please send it once you have the details. I just need the timing and drop-off spot so I can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Oh, the repair drive—are we definitely doing it this week?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to confirm the details first—do we have the date, time, and location set yet?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Not yet—I’m checking because I’m not sure we’ve locked that down.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Let’s keep it simple: tell me what needs fixing, and I’ll follow the plan.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I’m in — I’ll just point out the broken stuff and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Good, then we’re on the same page—just show me the repairs, and I’ll keep to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive is getting organized—what’s the latest on it?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve got a short list going—tools, tape, screws, and a few flashlights so far. If you hear of anything else we’re short on, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, I’ll keep an ear out and pass along anything I hear.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I’m sorry, my memory’s a bit all over the place, but I’m happy to help if you need me to bring something by.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Oren — that would help a lot. If you’re able, could you bring over any spare tools you have?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Of course — I’ll gather what I can find and bring over my spare tools soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—just let me know what time you’re thinking.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — afternoons work best for me. If you can check the school schedule, I’ll confirm a time and help set it up.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’ll check the school schedule and get back to you with a few afternoon options.
